accepted.sentence: During a triathlon, competitors switch from swimming to riding, leave their machines in a transition area, then begin the running leg.
During multiday tours, riders often plan overnight stops near campgrounds, hostels, or towns where repairs are available.
On expansive university campuses, students can travel between distant lecture halls without moving a car or searching for parking.
On narrow shared paths, people traveling on two wheels should slow near walkers and pass only when space allows.
On farms, sturdy utility models can carry tools or feed between barns, fields, and other nearby work sites.
On ferry routes that permit them, riders can bring personal transport across the water and continue their journey ashore.
At remote trailheads, travelers may secure their machines to exterior car racks before driving to routes far from home.
Some rehabilitation programs use adapted outdoor versions to help patients practice coordinated movement and build confidence.
